correctness.rationale: For any q>=3, closed stars at all first-column vertices cover the complex. Every pair intersection explicitly removes first column and two colors from second; connected for m>=3,q>=4 and m>=4,q=3. Star unions attach along connected intersections sharing a column-three vertex, so van Kampen gives pi1=0. The cyclic action has no fixed nonempty support; the deck group is Cq. All excluded cases have explicit graph/collapse models. Signed orbit-boundary matrices, boundary-square tests and exact Smith factors independently confirm ten cases; finite checks are not used as the all-order proof.

value.rationale: This classifies a canonical nontrivial topological invariant for a natural full infinite family of recently studied independence complexes. The sharp transition from free fundamental groups to arbitrary-order cyclic first-homology torsion of genuine geometric quotients is not encoded by the known Cohen–Macaulay/Buchsbaum classification. The first-homology group is a basic quotient obstruction useful in symmetry-aware combinatorial topology; this is not a single arbitrary computed sample.
